title: Global land point samples
credit: Made with Natural Earth. Land boundaries redistributed by World Atlas, Mike Bostock and contributors.
description: Deterministic, approximately equal-area points on the sphere, retained only when contained in the source global land polygons. These are geographic surface samples, not research measurements or flux-tower locations.

sampling.method: Fibonacci sphere followed by spherical point-in-polygon containment
sampling.rounding: Longitude and latitude rounded to 6 decimal places before containment.
sampling.notes: Fibonacci candidates are approximately uniform per spherical area, avoiding polar oversampling from a regular longitude/latitude grid. Small islands may receive no sample at this density.
